_about: Surfaces (21 §5.1) and every route the Platform Explorer renders, with scope tag, plan feature gate (plans.json features), module gate (tenant modules), permission gate (roles.json capability) and the spec that owns it.
domain_rule: rootline.com hosts Rootline-branded surfaces (marketing, the office app, the API). rootline.app hosts the console, tenant portals, mail and partner surfaces. rootline.site hosts tenant websites.
gating_order: surface: the role must use this surface
role roles[] list (non-web surfaces) or nav visibility (web, console, portal)
perm: the role must hold a grant other than - for the capability
module: the tenant must have the module enabled (hidden otherwise)
feature: the plan must include it (locked for buyers, hidden for others)
scope lens: shown with its MVP/V1/V2 tag
